Sandbox_SaveItemSpots_MaxPresetsPerTile_: Maximum number of saved position presets that can be created on a single tile.
Sandbox_SaveItemSpots_ShowCoordinates_to: If enabled, tile coordinates are shown next to preset names in context menus.
Sandbox_SaveItemSpots_FilterEquippedItem: If enabled, equipped items will not appear in the 'Place Saved Item' list.
